skill.displayName: Shopee-选品决策专家 | 青虎AI

llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed Shopee market-analysis workflow that uses a Qinghu API token and paid data tools with user approval, with no hidden install, persistence, or destructive behavior found.

dimensions.detail: The requested Qinghu token and HTTP API access are proportionate to retrieving third-party ecommerce data; the skill discloses paid calls, caps calls per turn, and avoids substituting scraping or similar tools.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Only a Markdown skill file is present; no executable install scripts, bundled code, package dependencies, or automatic setup actions were found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The trigger language is somewhat broad for Shopee reports, but the body narrows use to major project-level analysis, tells the agent to avoid daily product-picking use, asks for missing site information, and requires upfront user consent before tool calls.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No cross-session persistence, memory writing, privilege escalation, background workers, tool hijacking, or local credential-store access is instructed.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The artifact coherently supports Shopee selection-decision reporting by combining site, category, shop, item, price, and search-term data from Qinghu APIs.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this if you intentionally use Qinghu AI data for Shopee project-level selection reports. Be prepared to provide or configure a Qinghu API token and approve paid tool calls; use a lighter Shopee skill for quick product checks or routine recommendations.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The top-level description is broad, but artifact text keeps the workflow tied to Shopee project-level market reports and includes cost-confirmation controls before paid tool use.
[SQP-3] expected: The skill is written in Chinese and appears targeted at Qinghu/Shopee Chinese-language users; this is a usability/localization limitation rather than evidence of unsafe behavior.
[SQP-1] expected: The trigger examples overlap with lighter sibling skills, but the artifact explicitly warns this is for major analysis, points routine picking to another skill, and requires user authorization before calls.
